recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only through a new work-group issue if FHIR-I wants to add formal Schematron/invariant message localization or require per-documentation xml:lang on copied support schemas despite their inherited schema-level language.
issue_request: FHIR-3534 asked for formal i18n/l10n support for FHIR schemas and schematrons. Its Published/Persuasive with Modification resolution was to declare xml:lang on each xs:documentation repetition, with the application comment narrowing implementation to schema and noting that multi-language invariant translations were not added.
initial_application: Historical git-svn commit 6afec1f8ed93fe2aa5394eb48033461dd77dca6a, '#3534 - schema support for xml:lang', matches Jira's svn revision 5562 note and changed the old Java XSD generators to emit xml:lang on generated documentation entries plus localized documentation/designation repetitions when language data existed.
additional_context: The current core checkout still defines the schema-fed FHIR datatypes/resources and publishes XML Schema/Schematron artifacts, but the old Java generator source modified in 2015 no longer lives in this checkout. A current build fhir-all-xsd.zip scan found xml:lang on every FHIR-generated xs:documentation entry; the only untagged documentation entries were in copied support schemas xml.xsd and fhir-xhtml.xsd, where language is inherited from schema-level xml:lang="en" and which were not the target of the 2015 generator fix. No Zulip or Confluence evidence was found that broadens the applied issue.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because the current generated FHIR schema output already implements the approved localization mechanism, and adding new Schematron localization machinery would exceed the applied Jira decision.
